# Manuel Castillejo

> Resources published by Manuel Castillejo, creator of FlowSight. Shared ownership is stated in /about/.

Official product: https://flowsight.site

- [Manuel Castillejo — creator of FlowSight](https://mancasvel.github.io/): Manuel Castillejo builds FlowSight, a local AI work-intelligence app. Find the project, University of Seville reference, practical resources and public channels.
- [The FlowSight project by Manuel Castillejo](https://mancasvel.github.io/flowsight-project/): Explore Manuel Castillejo’s FlowSight project: local AI work context, reviewable summaries, public source, guides and current product documentation.
- [About these FlowSight resources](https://mancasvel.github.io/about/): These resources are published by Manuel Castillejo, creator of FlowSight. Learn their ownership, sources, editing policy and relationship to flowsight.site.
